standard_prerequisites.name: The description of a basis of the limit topology by pullbacks of open subsets
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 5090-5100)
standard_prerequisites.use: Expresses the given constructible subset in terms of finitely many pullbacks of open sets.

core_obligations: Express the subset: a constructible subset of the limit is a finite Boolean combination of pullbacks of open subsets, each of which already comes from some stage (proof lines 5089-5105)

Descend to a stage: since only finitely many stages are involved and the index set is directed, all the open sets involved come from a single stage, so the whole Boolean combination does too (proof lines 5106-5115)
proof_roadmap: 极限拓扑有由拉回开集组成的基 ⇒ 可构造子集是有限个拉回开集的布尔组合。
涉及的只有有限多个阶段，指标集有向 ⇒ 存在一个阶段同时承载全部 ⇒ 该布尔组合来自该阶段。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every constructible subset of an inverse limit of spectral spaces is the preimage of a constructible subset of one of the stages (author lemma at source lines 5078-5087, label lemma-inverse-limit-spectral-spaces-constructible). The proof (source lines 5089-5116) writes the subset as a finite Boolean combination of pullbacks of open sets and uses the directedness of the index set to place all of them at a single stage (proof lines 5089-5115). The finiteness-and-directedness step is the content. H3.
